title: Explorer empty state
responsibility: Says that a list or screen has nothing to show at this revision, and why.

inputs.name: EmptyState.as
inputs.description: Selects the native element used to render the empty state. Defaults to `p`; `div` is the only alternative.

inputs.name: EmptyState.className
inputs.description: Sets the rendered element's `class` attribute. Defaults to `ex-empty`, which enables the component's descendant-link spacing rule.

inputs.name: EmptyState.role
inputs.description: Sets the optional semantic role on the rendered element. Defaults to JavaScript `undefined`, which omits the role; accepted values are `note`, `status`, and `alert`.

inputs.name: EmptyState.id
inputs.description: Sets the rendered element's native `id`. Defaults to JavaScript `undefined` (omitted).

inputs.name: EmptyState.label
inputs.description: Sets the rendered element's `aria-label`. Defaults to JavaScript `undefined`, which omits the attribute.

inputs.name: EmptyState.component
inputs.description: Sets the rendered element's `data-harness-component` owner attribution. Defaults to JavaScript `undefined`.

inputs.name: EmptyState.children
inputs.description: Provides the required Svelte snippet rendered inside the selected element. Errors from rendering the snippet propagate to the owner.

outputs.name: EmptyState
outputs.description: Renders a `p` or `div` with the selected `class`, optional `role`, `id`, `aria-label`, and `data-harness-component`, and the required snippet as its content. Descendant links under `.ex-empty` receive `display: inline-block` and a `var(--hx-space-8)` inline-start margin.

errors.name: Content rendering error
errors.description: An error thrown while rendering the required `children` snippet propagates to the owner.
